title: "cache.invalidate"
sidebarTitle: "cache.invalidate"
description: "Xoa muc registry Instance cache da duoc cache cho Instance duoc cung cap."
keywords: ["cache.invalidate","Cache"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
cache.invalidate(instance: Instance)
```

## Đối số

<ParamField path={"instance"} type={"Instance"} required>
Instance co muc registry da cache can duoc xoa.
</ParamField>

## Ví dụ

Xoa mot Instance khoi cache cua Real va kiem tra xem muc cache con ton tai hay khong.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

cache.invalidate(Players)

print(cache.iscached(Players))
```


</div>
